teacherPlayback: Two complete playbacks controlled by the teacher. No student media controls.
scoreRule: 6 objectively scored multiple-choice tasks and 2 teacher-reviewed written tasks, 1 point each. Proposed grade only after both written tasks reviewed.
notes: Authentic dialogue includes aggression and profanity. Teacher must check age suitability and source recording.

objective.q: What is the man talking about?
objective.explanation: He tells the group how to behave during the event.
objective.sourceEvidence: He gives instructions for a wedding.

objective.explanation: The scene takes place before a wedding.
objective.sourceEvidence: He talks about his wedding day.

objective.explanation: A man complains about guests in uniform.

objective.q: What do the other men do?
objective.explanation: Different men interrupt while he tries to speak.

objective.q: What does the man want to stop?
objective.explanation: He wants to prevent fighting and other problems.
objective.sourceEvidence: He is giving rules to prevent trouble.

written.q: Write the first name of the woman he wants to protect.
written.teacherCriterion: One clearly recognisable correct first name.

written.q: Write one word to describe the main man's voice.
written.teacherCriterion: One appropriate adjective supported by the heard dialogue.
written.sourceEvidence: The speaker becomes forceful and angry.
